BASICDOS-360K:
REM BASIC-DOS release diskette configuration
SESSIONS=3
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS"
BASICDOS-360K-S80:
REM Demonstration of a single-console configuration
SESSIONS=3
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\TESTS" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-D40:
REM Demonstration of two 40-column consoles
SESSIONS=4
SKIP=COM1,COM2,LPT1
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS" : COLOR 7,1 : HELLO
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS" : DIR
BASICDOS-360K-D80:
REM Demonstration of two 80-column consoles
REM SESSIONS=2
CON=VKD$:80,16,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
CON=VKD$:80,9,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS"
BASICDOS-360K-P80:
REM Demonstration of Multiple Video Pages, on video pages 0, 1, and 2
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS" : FIBO.BAT
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS" : PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-P80PM:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) with extended memory, using shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-DUAL:
REM Demonstration of dual monitors with full-screen consoles
SESSIONS=4
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\TESTS" : PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,25,0,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\TESTS" : PIPES.BAT
BASICDOS-360K-MULTI:
REM Demonstration of dual monitors with multiple consoles per monitor
SESSIONS=8
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\TESTS" : FIBO.BAT
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\TESTS" : PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,15,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\TESTS" : COLOR 7,1 : PIPES.BAT
CON=VKD$:80,10,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\TESTS" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-SERIAL:
REM Local and serial displays, using shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,GENERIC
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-VT100:
REM Local display and VT100 terminal, with shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-DEBUG:
REM Local console, with the serial debugger exclusively on COM2
DEVICE=EXT\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-M64:
REM 64K demonstration with one session and no PIPE$ driver
REM FPU$ and PIPE$ (at 64K) and drivers for missing hardware skip themselves
BUFFERS=2
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS"
BASICDOS-360K-REAL:
REM Real mode (eg, for MZ programs like WOLF3D.EXE), using a shell on the hard disk
CPU=8088
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-TERM:
REM 64K demonstration with no video: one console on a VT100 connected to COM1
REM FPU$ and PIPE$ (at 64K) and drivers for missing hardware skip themselves
SKIP=VKD$
BUFFERS=2
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS"
BASICDOS-360K-TERMHD:
REM No video: one console on a VT100 connected to COM1, with its shell on the hard disk
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
BASICDOS-360K-TERM2:
REM No video: two consoles, on VT100s connected to COM1 and COM2, with shells on the hard disk
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
CON=COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-MMU:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) with extended memory, and DEBUG.COM on COM2
DEVICE=EXT\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-10MB:
REM Single 80x25 console on a hard disk
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\TOOLS\BIN" : HELLO
